bindings.caption: Precipitate with acetonitrile and redissolve in toluene. MA: four precipitation cycles. ODPA-derived workup: initial precipitation followed by three additional alternating clarification/precipitation iterations. Each clarification keeps toluene supernatant; each precipitation keeps product. Amounts and centrifuge settings unreported. Retained fraction: precipitated product; discard supernatant. general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
